---
title: "Sustainability and Maintenance"
description: "How serious games can remain available, trustworthy and maintainable after a study ends"
---

A study, a public product and a maintained service are different objects. An article can remain available after its software stops working; an app can remain downloadable after its evaluated version has changed.

1. [Availability](../games/availability.qmd) documents whether research games could be obtained.
2. [Why games disappear](why-games-disappear.qmd) separates documented barriers from hypotheses about funding, staff turnover and clinical adoption.
3. [Maintenance patterns](maintenance-patterns.qmd) specifies ownership, reproducible releases, testing, handover and retirement.

Not every prototype needs an indefinite service life. A time-limited experiment should state that status and preserve the version and records needed to interpret its findings.
